scope.closure_reason: User-authorized launch-quality remediation: replace answer-path leakage, repeated template analysis, missing quality metadata, untraced provenance, and non-functional listening tasks with eight evidence-bounded audio-first candidate cards while preserving all card IDs and the interaction sequence. Content-text review is complete; formal audio-asset delivery and named-human perceptual QC remain separate required gates.

manual_quality_checks.authoritative_placement: Passed: prefix 1620 matches CET6 语法 / 虚拟语气 / 听力 and the catalog-owned eight-card count; top-level track and contract metadata are preserved.
manual_quality_checks.independent_tasks: Passed: every front omits transcript text and requires playback; neutral task schemas no longer reveal the answer or semantic conclusion before listening.
manual_quality_checks.independent_content_review: Passed after remediation: independent read-only reviews found and closed four task-schema answer leaks, one unnatural distractor, one role-inference overreach, three Chinese phrasing issues, and one top-level contract-metadata regression. Final content-text replay found no residual P0, P1, or P2.
manual_quality_checks.listening_ownership: Passed for candidate content: the cards train weak-form recovery, counterfactual reality restoration, overdue-action stance, appearance-versus-fact correction, modal-strength control, and multi-layer listening integration rather than written-form recognition alone.
manual_quality_checks.audio_first_boundary: Passed for card payload: all eight fronts are audio-first/audio-then-options, contain no transcript or subtitle, allow explicit user replay, and use only asset_id, sha256, duration_ms, and transcript in the product-truth audio descriptor.
manual_quality_checks.candidate_asset_identity: Technically matched only: all eight descriptors exactly match the generated temporary MP3 hashes and durations. This does not constitute formal repository asset delivery or perceptual review.
manual_quality_checks.formal_audio_gate: Open and not waived: the repository audio bytes are not delivered on this content branch, the first six legacy files do not match the new descriptors, files 162007 and 162008 are absent on main, and no named human has completed the required blind plus transcript-assisted listening passes.
manual_quality_checks.tts_review_flags: Correctly conservative: tts_text_reviewed is true after independent script review; tts_audio_reviewed remains false for every card until named-human perceptual QC is recorded.
manual_quality_checks.unique_answers: Passed: each multiple-choice item has one contextually and grammatically best answer; the elimination target is uniquely ②⑤; flip tasks require evidence-bounded free recall.
manual_quality_checks.canonical_option_migration: Passed: type-8 cards 162003 and 162007 have options matching form_options in text, order, and correctness, with synchronized answer_key values.
manual_quality_checks.interaction_parity: Passed: four multiple-choice answer_keys match sole correct options, elimination correct_items match exactly two target items, and flip cards remain unscored.
manual_quality_checks.metadata_enum: Passed: every weak_point_tag, difficulty, prototype, material type, review state, and progression role is schema-valid.
manual_quality_checks.adjacent_box_separation: Passed: 1620 owns audio-first listening recovery without duplicating 1621 reading inference, 1622 bilingual equivalence/form encoding, or 1623 writing argument construction.
manual_quality_checks.source_boundary: Passed: all scripts are declared synthetic simulations, explicitly claim no true-exam provenance, and do not imply official CET source material.
